'''2011 Tatooine Regionals Jesse Clark LS Kashyyyk (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jesse Clark]] at [[2011 Tatooine Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Kashyyyk (V)|VB5-L-kashyyyk-pre.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Wookie Mains
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
